title: PIXL 8000 Pineapple Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pineapple Ice combines juicy Pineapple flavour with a cool Menthol twist for a tangy, refreshing vape. A tropical flavour with a crisp exhale that keeps things light and breezy. This pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and comes with a 10ml refill reservoir. With the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup supports up to 8000 puffs. Mesh coil technology keeps flavour bright and consistent. Suitable for MTL vaping, Pineapple Ice is a simple, flavourful pod option with draw activation and Boost Mode for extra vapour when you want it. Perfect for fans of fruity blends with a cool edge.
